verdict.rationale: Parsec documents its own stylus forwarding: Wacom tablet support with pressure and tilt, and pressure-sensitive pens in Warp. That covers the stylus half of the story. An Android client exists, but nothing says touch input on a phone or tablet maps to host pointer events. missing for 10: touch-to-pointer mapping on phone/tablet clients, stylus support on mobile devices (as opposed to Wacom tablets), independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a power user, touch and stylus input on a tablet or phone maps to pointer events on the host

citations.quote: Full Wacom tablet support with pressure + tilt
Warp is enhanced with support for pressure sensitive pens and Wacom tablets
Your controllers, Wacom tablet, software, and monitors can now go anywhere you want.
